text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... So this is a real racing magazine 
reporter's notepad...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looking at it like this, it's full of 
rushed scribbles... It's so unsightly, I'm 
terribly embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... thank you so much for showing me 
something so precious...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming school newspaper special 
feature, "The Making of Monthly 
Twinkle"... I'll definitely make it a 
great article...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I look forward to reading it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels pretty refreshing to be 
the one being interviewed for a change.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I also... got to hear stories from the 
person who actually writes the articles I 
usually read, which gave me brand new 
insights...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... As soon as I get back, I might 
need to update my methodology for 
analyzing magazine race reviews...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
—Could that possibly be... the fabled 
"Genesis Method"...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That is fascinating! Based on this 
interview, what specific points will you 
be focusing on for the upcoming update!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Ah, w-wait just a moment...!
